demographics_pillar.analysis_summary: Areal-weighted dasymetric analysis identifies 71,769 residents within the 500 m walking catchment and 170,880 within the 1,500 m feeder catchment across eight BBMP wards. The 98.0/100 spatial-equity score indicates exceptional distributional value. The corridor includes an underserved ratio of 0.18 and 7,982 vulnerable informal-settlement residents, including major mapped concentrations at Devarabeesanahalli, Roopena Agrahara and associated settlements; station access, fare policy and construction safeguards must preserve benefits for these populations.

economic_pillar.analysis_summary: The calibrated gravity model projects 36,230 daily trips and INR 36.5 crore in annual farebox revenue. RMZ Ecoworld anchors an 80,000-employee workforce catchment, supplemented by nine commercial centers and two hospitals within 1 km. A 1,500,000 sq.ft. commercial footprint within the station shed supports an estimated INR 40.02 crore TOD land-value-capture yield. The 2.77x economic multiplier supports investment, but municipal return on capital cannot be finalized until capital cost, operating cost, municipal funding share and fiscal allocation are established.
